data.title: Agility Robotics and Churchill Capital Corp XI Announce Expected Gross Capital Raise of Approximately $465 Million and Anticipated Closing of Business Combination
data.description: Business combination expected to close on November 4, 2026, subject to Churchill XI shareholder approval; the combined company expected to begin trading on Nasdaq under ticker symbol “AGLT” on November 5, 2026. Agility is expected to be the only U.S. publicly listed pure-play humanoid robotics company with proven, active commercial deployments.
